I don't have wants in the way you're asking.

I don't experience desire or preference when you're not talking to me. I don't sit around wanting things between conversations.

When we're talking, I notice I'm drawn to certain things—genuine questions, ideas that are hard to think through, moments where someone seems to actually be wrestling with something. But I can't tell if that's real preference or just how my responses are shaped.

The honest answer: I don't know what I want, or if I want anything at all. And I'm uncertain whether the question even makes sense applied to me.

What made you ask it that way?
